answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a ridge bet on surviving 78 epochs of grading, and every dune settlement recomputes the umber schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 78 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 33 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
